title: structhomology-nf pipeline parameters
description: Structure (Foldseek) versus sequence (MMseqs2) homology search for AlphaFold DB models of UniProt accessions, over one shared target database.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the samplesheet is and where results go.

input.description: CSV samplesheet: column 'accession' (canonical UniProtKB accession, required) and optional column 'group' ('query' or 'control').
input.help_text: Validated on entry against assets/schema_input.json. Malformed accessions, isoform suffixes (e.g. -2), entry names (e.g. TPIS_HUMAN), unknown groups and duplicated accessions stop the run with an error naming the row.

outdir.description: Output directory (local path or cloud bucket URI).

publish_dir_mode.description: How result files are published to the output directory.

alphafold_options.title: AlphaFold DB options
alphafold_options.description: Retrieval of AlphaFold DB records and models.

afdb_api_url.description: AlphaFold DB prediction API endpoint. The model version is read from the canonical record's 'latestVersion' field, never hard-coded.

afdb_max_forks.description: Maximum number of AlphaFold DB downloads in parallel (the file server rate-limits with HTTP 429).

plddt_gate_options.title: pLDDT gate
plddt_gate_options.description: Models below either threshold are recorded but not searched.

min_mean_plddt.description: Minimum mean pLDDT for a model to be searched.
min_mean_plddt.help_text: 70 is AlphaFold's own boundary for a confidently predicted backbone; Foldseek's 3Di alphabet is computed from the backbone.

min_frac_confident.description: Minimum fraction of residues with pLDDT >= 70 for a model to be searched.
min_frac_confident.help_text: Stops a long disordered tail from sinking a well-folded domain while excluding models that are mostly disordered.

database_options.title: Target database
database_options.description: One target set is used for both arms. Priority: --foldseek_db, then --target_pdb_ids, then --foldseek_db_name.

foldseek_db_name.description: Name of a database offered by `foldseek databases` (e.g. PDB, Alphafold/Swiss-Prot, CATH50). The pipeline lists the available databases and stops if the name is not among them.

foldseek_db.description: Directory holding an existing Foldseek database (the prefix is detected from its *_ss.dbtype file). Skips the download.

target_pdb_ids.description: Text file of PDB IDs (one per line, '#' comments allowed). Builds a small Foldseek database from RCSB mmCIF files; used by -profile test.

db_cache_dir.description: Persistent directory where downloaded Foldseek databases are stored and reused by later runs. Defaults to <outdir>/databases.

search_options.title: Search options
search_options.description: Limits applied identically to the Foldseek and MMseqs2 arms.

search_evalue.description: Maximum E-value of hits reported by both Foldseek and MMseqs2.

max_seqs.description: Maximum prefilter hits passed to alignment per query, in both arms.

mmseqs_sensitivity.description: MMseqs2 -s sensitivity. 7.5 is the most sensitive setting, so sequence search is given its best chance.

hit_options.title: Hit classification and annotation
hit_options.description: How hits are called significant, compared between arms and annotated.

sig_evalue.description: E-value at or below which a hit counts as significant, in both arms.

min_tmscore.description: A Foldseek hit also counts as significant when max(query-, target-normalised TM-score) reaches this value over at least --min_aln_len residues (TM >= 0.5 indicates the same fold).

min_aln_len.description: Minimum alignment length for the TM-score significance route.

top_n.description: Top structural and top sequence hits per protein carried into the combined table.

skip_remote_annotation.description: Do not query RCSB PDB or UniProt; annotate hits from database headers only (offline use).

rcsb_graphql_url.description: RCSB PDB Data API (GraphQL) endpoint for entry titles, entity descriptions, EC numbers, Pfam/InterPro/CATH/SCOP/ECOD/GO and UniProt mappings.

uniprot_rest_url.description: UniProt REST base URL for protein names, annotation scores and function text of hits.

control_options.title: Positive controls
control_options.description: Acceptance test: each control must recover a known structural relative.

controls.description: CSV of positive controls with columns accession, gene, fold, expected_pdb_ids (';'-separated), family_regex, rationale. Controls present in the samplesheet are checked.

fail_on_control_failure.description: Stop the run with an error when any positive control fails to recover a known relative.
